parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query.

parameters.name: InstanceType
parameters.description:
The query type. Valid values:

- spn: savings plan instance

- product: deducted cloud service instance

parameters.name: Locale
parameters.description: The language of the response. Default value: ZH. Valid values: \`ZH\`: Chinese. \`EN\`: English.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query.
